caption: The drawing features a decorative floral pattern on a yellow background. The composition includes several large green leafy vines with curving branches spreading horizontally and vertically across the image. Among the vines are various types of flowers, primarily in shades of pink, with accents of white and soft red. Some flowers are large and open with multiple petals, while others are smaller and more closed. Brown stems and leaves connect the flowers and vines, and small red and yellow details enhance the foliage and blossoms. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a horizontal decorative border with a reddish-pink background and a repeating floral motif in white and pink, bordered by two thin yellow lines. The entire arrangement is framed by a narrow light beige border.
title: Wallpaper Border
